> **Low Risk**
> Mostly additive code (new pure state machine, tests, and doc generation) with no existing hook/session behavior wired to it yet; main risk is future integration relying on these transition semantics.
> 
> **Overview**
> Adds a standalone session lifecycle phase state machine (`phase.go`) with four phases and five events, returning declarative `Actions` from a pure `Transition()` function (including backward-compat normalization and a rebase no-op guard).
> 
> Introduces comprehensive table-driven tests for all phase/event combinations plus backward-compat and diagram assertions, and adds a `go generate` helper (`gen_state_diagram.go`) that writes a Mermaid diagram to `docs/generated/` (with that directory ignored except for `.gitignore`).
> 
> Updates dependencies to include `github.com/stretchr/testify` for the new test suite.

=== PR #170 ===
Wire session.Transition() into hook handlers (ENT-221)
---
## Summary

- Wire `session.Transition()` into 4 hook handler integration points so phase transitions actually happen at runtime
- Add `ApplyCommonActions()` helper that consumes common actions (UpdateLastInteraction, ClearEndedAt) and returns strategy-specific actions for caller dispatch

## Integration Points

| Hook | Event | Transition |
|------|-------|------------|
| `InitializeSession()` | EventTurnStart | IDLE→ACTIVE, Ctrl-C recovery, ENDED→ACTIVE |
| `commitWithMetadata()` | EventTurnEnd | ACTIVE→IDLE (both normal and early-return paths) |
| `markSessionEnded()` | EventSessionStop | any→ENDED |
| `handleSessionStartCommon()` | EventSessionStart | ENDED→IDLE (re-entering session) |

## Stacked on

- **PR 3**: `PostCommit()` → EventGitCommit + phase-aware condensation
- **PR 4**: ActionWarnStaleSession dispatch, cleanup

=== PR #172 ===
Phase-aware PostCommit and PrepareCommitMsg amend fix (ENT-221)
---
## Summary

- Wire session state machine into `PostCommit()` — each session transitions via `EventGitCommit` with phase-aware action dispatch (ACTIVE defers, IDLE condenses, ACTIVE_COMMITTED migrates, ENDED condenses-if-files-touched)
- Fix `git commit --amend -m` trailer loss in `PrepareCommitMsg()` — restore `Entire-Checkpoint` trailer from `PendingCheckpointID` in session state
- Shadow branches only deleted when ALL sessions on the branch are non-active

**Stacked on:** #170 (`alex/ent-221-wire-up-state-machine`)

## Details

### PostCommit (Task 5)
- Each session goes through `session.Transition(EventGitCommit)` and dispatches strategy-specific actions
- Rebase/cherry-pick/revert operations skip all phase transitions via `isGitSequenceOperation()`
- Shadow branch deletion gated on `activeSessionsOnBranch` tracking
- Content check errors use fail-open policy (assume new content)
- Sets `PendingCheckpointID` on condensed sessions for amend restoration

### PrepareCommitMsg Amend Fix (Task 6)
- Removed `"commit"` from early-return switch (was the root cause of the amend bug)
- Added `handleAmendCommitMsg()` — preserves existing trailer or restores from `PendingCheckpointID`
- Normal commits check `PendingCheckpointID` before generating new IDs (idempotent checkpoint IDs)
- `PendingCheckpointID` lifecycle: set on condense, cleared on new prompt (`InitializeSession`) and new checkpoint (`SaveChanges`)

## Test plan
- [x] 4 PostCommit phase tests (active deferral, idle condensation, rebase skip, multi-session shadow branch preservation)
- [x] 4 PrepareCommitMsg tests (amend preserve, amend restore from pending ID, amend no-op, normal commit reuse pending ID)
- [x] All existing unit tests pass
- [x] All integration tests pass (including `LastCheckpointID` and `FullTranscriptCondensation` tests)

> **Overview**
> Integrates the session phase state machine into `ManualCommitStrategy.PostCommit`, dispatching per-session actions on `EventGitCommit` (defer condensation for ACTIVE, condense for IDLE, migrate shadow branches for ACTIVE_COMMITTED, and condense/discard behavior for ENDED), and skips phase transitions during rebase/cherry-pick/revert sequences.
>

Shadow branch cleanup is tightened to only delete a branch when **all** sessions sharing it are non-active, and `PendingCheckpointID` is cleared on new prompts and when new checkpoint content is saved.

## Summary

- **Replace `current_session` file** with `FindMostRecentSession()` — eliminates the file-based session tracking mechanism in favor of querying session state files directly
- **Fix non-interactive `git commit --amend -m`** silently dropping checkpoint trailer — detects `isRestoringExisting` (PendingCheckpointID or LastCheckpointID set) and skips the TTY prompt that would fail silently in non-interactive environments (e.g., Claude doing amends)
- **Add `TransitionAndLog()`** as single entry point for all 6 state machine transition call sites, with consistent INFO logging for phase changes and DEBUG for no-ops
- **Add `entire sessions fix`** command for recovering stuck sessions (active+stale or ended+uncondensed)
- **Enhance `entire reset`** with `--session` flag for targeted reset and active session guards
- **Add integration tests** for commit-before-stop (ACTIVE → ACTIVE_COMMITTED → IDLE) and amend-preserves-trailer flows
- **Add table-driven unit test** for PendingCheckpointID reuse across `source=""` and `source="message"` paths

## Stack

This is PR 4 in the ENT-221 stack:
1. `alex/ent-221-wire-up-state-machine` — Pure session phase state machine
2. `alex/ent-221-type-consolidation` — Consolidate session state types
3. `alex/ent-221-phase-aware-git-hooks` — Wire state machine into hooks
4. **`alex/ent-221-cleanup-and-sessions-fix`** ← this PR

## Test plan

- [x] `mise run fmt` — clean
- [x] `mise run lint` — 0 issues
- [x] `mise run test:ci` — all unit + integration tests pass
- [x] New unit test `TestPrepareCommitMsg_PendingCheckpointIDReuse` covers both `source=""` and `source="message"` paths
- [x] New integration tests `TestShadow_CommitBeforeStop` and `TestShadow_AmendPreservesTrailer`
- [ ] Manual: verify `git commit --amend -m` preserves trailer in a real session

> [!NOTE]
> **Medium Risk**
> Touches git hook behavior, session state discovery, and condensation/reset flows; mistakes could drop checkpoint trailers or incorrectly condense/discard session data, though changes are covered by new unit/integration tests.
> 
> **Overview**
> Eliminates the `.entire/current_session` mechanism and updates hooks/debug/logging to derive the “current” session via `strategy.FindMostRecentSession()` over `.git/entire-sessions` state files (including removing `current_session` from `.entire/.gitignore` management).
> 
> Centralizes session phase transitions through `strategy.TransitionAndLog()` (consistent phase-change logging) and updates hook handlers accordingly; Gemini’s AfterAgent flow now also emits a TurnEnd transition.
> 
> Fixes manual-commit `prepare-commit-msg` behavior for `source="message"` so non-interactive `git commit --amend -m` restores/keeps the `Entire-Checkpoint` trailer when reusing an existing checkpoint (skipping the `/dev/tty` confirmation path).
> 
> Adds session maintenance commands: `entire sessions fix` to detect stale/ended-but-uncondensed sessions and condense or discard them, and extends `entire reset` with `--session` plus a guard against bulk reset when sessions on HEAD are still active; introduces strategy interfaces/impls (`SessionCondenser`, per-session `ResetSession`, and manual-commit `CondenseSessionByID`).
> 
> Expands test coverage with new integration tests for ACTIVE→ACTIVE_COMMITTED→IDLE and amend-trailer preservation, plus updated/unit tests to reflect state-file-based session discovery and pending checkpoint ID reuse.
>

  "new_string": "// activeSessionsOnCurrentHead returns sessions on the current HEAD\n// that are in an active phase (ACTIVE or ACTIVE_COMMITTED).\nfunc activeSessionsOnCurrentHead() ([]*session.State, error) {\n\trepo, err := openRepository()\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn nil, err\n\t}\n\n\thead, err := repo.Head()\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn nil, fmt.Errorf(\"failed to get HEAD: %w\", err)\n\t}\n\tcurrentHead := head.Hash().String()\n\n\tstates, err := strategy.ListSessionStates()\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn nil, fmt.Errorf(\"failed to list session states: %w\", err)\n\t}\n\n\tvar active []*session.State\n\tfor _, state := range states {\n\t\tif state.BaseCommit != currentHead {\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t}\n\t\tphase := session.PhaseFromString(string(state.Phase))\n\t\tif phase.IsActive() {\n\t\t\tactive = append(active, state)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\n\treturn active, nil\n}"

   170→// classifySession determines if a session is stuck and returns diagnostic info.
   171→// Returns nil if the session is healthy.
   172→func classifySession(state *strategy.SessionState, repo *git.Repository, now time.Time) *stuckSession {
   173→	// Determine shadow branch info
   174→	shadowBranch := checkpoint.ShadowBranchNameForCommit(state.BaseCommit, state.WorktreeID)
   175→	refName := plumbing.NewBranchReferenceName(shadowBranch)
   176→	_, refErr := repo.Reference(refName, true)
   177→	hasShadowBranch := refErr == nil
   178→
   179→	phase := session.PhaseFromString(string(state.Phase))
   180→
   181→	switch {
   182→	case phase.IsActive():
   183→		// Active sessions are stuck if no interaction for over the staleness threshold
   184→		isStale := state.LastInteractionTime == nil || now.Sub(*state.LastInteractionTime) > stalenessThreshold
   185→		if !isStale {
   186→			return nil
   187→		}
   188→
   189→		var reason string
   190→		if state.LastInteractionTime != nil {
   191→			reason = fmt.Sprintf("active, last interaction %s ago", now.Sub(*state.LastInteractionTime).Truncate(time.Minute))
   192→		} else {
   193→			reason = "active, no recorded interaction time"
   194→		}
   195→
   196→		return &stuckSession{
   197→			State:             state,
   198→			Reason:            reason,
   199→			ShadowBranch:      shadowBranch,
   200→			HasShadowBranch:   hasShadowBranch,
   201→			CheckpointCount:   state.StepCount,
   202→			FilesTouchedCount: len(state.FilesTouched),
   203→		}
   204→
   205→	case phase == session.PhaseEnded:
   206→		// Ended sessions are stuck if they have uncondensed data
   207→		if state.StepCount <= 0 || !hasShadowBranch {
   208→			return nil
   209→		}
   210→
   211→		return &stuckSession{
   212→			State:             state,
   213→			Reason:            "ended with uncondensed checkpoint data",
   214→			ShadowBranch:      shadowBranch,
   215→			HasShadowBranch:   hasShadowBranch,
   216→			CheckpointCount:   state.StepCount,
   217→			FilesTouchedCount: len(state.FilesTouched),
   218→		}
   219→
   220→	default:
   221→		return nil
   222→	}
   223→}
   224→
   225→// displayStuckSession prints diagnostic info for a stuck session.
   226→func displayStuckSession(cmd *cobra.Command, ss stuckSession) {
   227→	w := cmd.OutOrStdout()
   228→
   229→	fmt.Fprintf(w, "  Session: %s\n", ss.State.SessionID)
   230→	fmt.Fprintf(w, "  Phase:   %s\n", ss.State.Phase)
   231→	fmt.Fprintf(w, "  Reason:  %s\n", ss.Reason)
   232→
   233→	if ss.State.AgentType != "" {
   234→		fmt.Fprintf(w, "  Agent:   %s\n", ss.State.AgentType)
   235→	}
   236→
   237→	if ss.State.LastInteractionTime != nil {
   238→		fmt.Fprintf(w, "  Last interaction: %s\n", ss.State.LastInteractionTime.Format(time.RFC3339))
   239→	}
   240→
   241→	shadowStatus := "not found"
   242→	if ss.HasShadowBranch {
   243→		shadowStatus = fmt.Sprintf("exists (%s)", ss.ShadowBranch)
   244→	}
   245→	fmt.Fprintf(w, "  Shadow branch: %s\n", shadowStatus)
   246→	fmt.Fprintf(w, "  Checkpoints: %d, Files touched: %d\n", ss.CheckpointCount, ss.FilesTouchedCount)
   247→}
   248→
   249→// promptSessionAction asks the user what to do with a stuck session.
   250→func promptSessionAction(ss stuckSession, canCondense bool) (string, error) {
   251→	var action string
   252→
   253→	options := make([]huh.Option[string], 0, 3)
   254→	if canCondense && ss.HasShadowBranch && ss.CheckpointCount > 0 {
   255→		options = append(options, huh.NewOption("Condense (save to permanent storage)", "condense"))
   256→	}
   257→	options = append(options,
   258→		huh.NewOption("Discard (remove session data)", "discard"),
   259→		huh.NewOption("Skip (leave as-is)", "skip"),
   260→	)
   261→
   262→	form := NewAccessibleForm(
   263→		huh.NewGroup(
   264→			huh.NewSelect[string]().
   265→				Title(fmt.Sprintf("Fix session %s?", ss.State.SessionID)).
   266→				Options(options...).
   267→				Value(&action),
   268→		),
   269→	)
   270→
   271→	if err := form.Run(); err != nil {
   272→		return "", fmt.Errorf("session fix prompt failed: %w", err)
   273→	}
   274→
   275→	return action, nil
   276→}
   277→
   278→// discardSession removes session state and cleans up the shadow branch.
   279→func discardSession(ss stuckSession, repo *git.Repository) error {
   280→	// Clear session state file
   281→	if err := strategy.ClearSessionState(ss.State.SessionID); err != nil {
   282→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to clear session state: %w", err)
   283→	}
   284→
   285→	// Delete shadow branch if it exists and no other sessions need it
   286→	if ss.HasShadowBranch {
   287→		if shouldDelete, err := canDeleteShadowBranch(ss.ShadowBranch, ss.State.SessionID); err != nil {
   288→			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Warning: could not check other sessions for shadow branch: %v\n", err)
   289→		} else if shouldDelete {
   290→			refName := plumbing.NewBranchReferenceName(ss.ShadowBranch)
   291→			ref, refErr := repo.Reference(refName, true)
   292→			if refErr == nil {
   293→				if err := repo.Storer.RemoveReference(ref.Name()); err != nil {
   294→					return fmt.Errorf("failed to delete shadow branch: %w", err)
   295→				}
   296→			}
   297→		}
   298→	}
   299→
   300→	return nil
   301→}
   302→
   303→// canDeleteShadowBranch checks if a shadow branch can be safely deleted.
   304→// Returns true if no other sessions (besides excludeSessionID) need this branch.
   305→func canDeleteShadowBranch(shadowBranch, excludeSessionID string) (bool, error) {
   306→	states, err := strategy.ListSessionStates()
   307→	if err != nil {
   308→		return false, fmt.Errorf("failed to list session states: %w", err)
   309→	}
   310→
   311→	for _, state := range states {
   312→		if state.SessionID == excludeSessionID {
   313→			continue
   314→		}
   315→		otherShadow := checkpoint.ShadowBranchNameForCommit(state.BaseCommit, state.WorktreeID)
   316→		if otherShadow == shadowBranch && state.StepCount > 0 {
   317→			return false, nil
   318→		}
   319→	}
   320→
   321→	return true, nil
   322→}
   323→

   171→//     skipping the interactive TTY prompt. This is critical for non-interactive

    75→func runSessionsFix(cmd *cobra.Command, force bool) error {

    97→	for _, state := range states {

   113→	fmt.Fprintf(cmd.OutOrStdout(), "Found %d stuck session(s):\n\n", len(stuck))

   140→				return nil
   141→			}
   142→			return fmt.Errorf("failed to get action: %w", err)
   143→		}
   144→
   145→		switch action {
   146→		case "condense":
   147→			if !canCondense {
   148→				fmt.Fprintf(cmd.ErrOrStderr(), "Strategy %s does not support condensation\n", strat.Name())
   149→				continue
   150→			}
   151→			if err := condenser.CondenseSessionByID(ss.State.SessionID); err != nil {
   152→				fmt.Fprintf(cmd.ErrOrStderr(), "Warning: failed to condense session %s: %v\n", ss.State.SessionID, err)
   153→			} else {

   155→			}

   159→			} else {

   161→			}

   164→		}

   170→// classifySession determines if a session is stuck and returns diagnostic info.
   171→// Returns nil if the session is healthy.
   172→func classifySession(state *strategy.SessionState, repo *git.Repository, now time.Time) *stuckSession {
   173→	// Determine shadow branch info
   174→	shadowBranch := checkpoint.ShadowBranchNameForCommit(state.BaseCommit, state.WorktreeID)
   175→	refName := plumbing.NewBranchReferenceName(shadowBranch)
   176→	_, refErr := repo.Reference(refName, true)
   177→	hasShadowBranch := refErr == nil
   178→
   179→	phase := session.PhaseFromString(string(state.Phase))
   180→
   181→	switch {
   182→	case phase.IsActive():
   183→		// Active sessions are stuck if no interaction for over the staleness threshold
   184→		isStale := state.LastInteractionTime == nil || now.Sub(*state.LastInteractionTime) > stalenessThreshold
   185→		if !isStale {
   186→			return nil
   187→		}
   188→
   189→		var reason string
   190→		if state.LastInteractionTime != nil {
   191→			reason = fmt.Sprintf("active, last interaction %s ago", now.Sub(*state.LastInteractionTime).Truncate(time.Minute))
   192→		} else {
   193→			reason = "active, no recorded interaction time"
   194→		}
   195→
   196→		return &stuckSession{
   197→			State:             state,
   198→			Reason:            reason,
   199→			ShadowBranch:      shadowBranch,
   200→			HasShadowBranch:   hasShadowBranch,
   201→			CheckpointCount:   state.StepCount,
   202→			FilesTouchedCount: len(state.FilesTouched),
   203→		}
   204→
   205→	case phase == session.PhaseEnded:
   206→		// Ended sessions are stuck if they have uncondensed data
   207→		if state.StepCount <= 0 || !hasShadowBranch {
   208→			return nil
   209→		}
   210→
   211→		return &stuckSession{
   212→			State:             state,
   213→			Reason:            "ended with uncondensed checkpoint data",
   214→			ShadowBranch:      shadowBranch,
   215→			HasShadowBranch:   hasShadowBranch,
   216→			CheckpointCount:   state.StepCount,
   217→			FilesTouchedCount: len(state.FilesTouched),
   218→		}
   219→
   220→	default:
   221→		return nil
   222→	}
   223→}
   224→
   225→// displayStuckSession prints diagnostic info for a stuck session.
   226→func displayStuckSession(cmd *cobra.Command, ss stuckSession) {
   227→	w := cmd.OutOrStdout()
   228→
   229→	fmt.Fprintf(w, "  Session: %s\n", ss.State.SessionID)
   230→	fmt.Fprintf(w, "  Phase:   %s\n", ss.State.Phase)
   231→	fmt.Fprintf(w, "  Reason:  %s\n", ss.Reason)
   232→
   233→	if ss.State.AgentType != "" {
   234→		fmt.Fprintf(w, "  Agent:   %s\n", ss.State.AgentType)
   235→	}
   236→
   237→	if ss.State.LastInteractionTime != nil {
   238→		fmt.Fprintf(w, "  Last interaction: %s\n", ss.State.LastInteractionTime.Format(time.RFC3339))
   239→	}
   240→
   241→	shadowStatus := "not found"
   242→	if ss.HasShadowBranch {
   243→		shadowStatus = fmt.Sprintf("exists (%s)", ss.ShadowBranch)
   244→	}
   245→	fmt.Fprintf(w, "  Shadow branch: %s\n", shadowStatus)
   246→	fmt.Fprintf(w, "  Checkpoints: %d, Files touched: %d\n", ss.CheckpointCount, ss.FilesTouchedCount)
   247→}
   248→
   249→// promptSessionAction asks the user what to do with a stuck session.
   250→func promptSessionAction(ss stuckSession, canCondense bool) (string, error) {
   251→	var action string
   252→
   253→	options := make([]huh.Option[string], 0, 3)
   254→	if canCondense && ss.HasShadowBranch && ss.CheckpointCount > 0 {
   255→		options = append(options, huh.NewOption("Condense (save to permanent storage)", "condense"))
   256→	}
   257→	options = append(options,
   258→		huh.NewOption("Discard (remove session data)", "discard"),
   259→		huh.NewOption("Skip (leave as-is)", "skip"),
   260→	)
   261→
   262→	form := NewAccessibleForm(
   263→		huh.NewGroup(
   264→			huh.NewSelect[string]().
   265→				Title(fmt.Sprintf("Fix session %s?", ss.State.SessionID)).
   266→				Options(options...).
   267→				Value(&action),
   268→		),
   269→	)
   270→
   271→	if err := form.Run(); err != nil {
   272→		return "", fmt.Errorf("session fix prompt failed: %w", err)
   273→	}
   274→
   275→	return action, nil
   276→}
   277→
   278→// discardSession removes session state and cleans up the shadow branch.
   279→func discardSession(ss stuckSession, repo *git.Repository) error {
   280→	// Clear session state file
   281→	if err := strategy.ClearSessionState(ss.State.SessionID); err != nil {
   282→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to clear session state: %w", err)
   283→	}
   284→
   285→	// Delete shadow branch if it exists and no other sessions need it
   286→	if ss.HasShadowBranch {
   287→		if shouldDelete, err := canDeleteShadowBranch(ss.ShadowBranch, ss.State.SessionID); err != nil {
   288→			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Warning: could not check other sessions for shadow branch: %v\n", err)
   289→		} else if shouldDelete {
   290→			refName := plumbing.NewBranchReferenceName(ss.ShadowBranch)
   291→			ref, refErr := repo.Reference(refName, true)
   292→			if refErr == nil {
   293→				if err := repo.Storer.RemoveReference(ref.Name()); err != nil {
   294→					return fmt.Errorf("failed to delete shadow branch: %w", err)
   295→				}
   296→			}
   297→		}
   298→	}
   299→
   300→	return nil
   301→}
   302→
   303→// canDeleteShadowBranch checks if a shadow branch can be safely deleted.
   304→// Returns true if no other sessions (besides excludeSessionID) need this branch.
   305→func canDeleteShadowBranch(shadowBranch, excludeSessionID string) (bool, error) {
   306→	states, err := strategy.ListSessionStates()
   307→	if err != nil {
   308→		return false, fmt.Errorf("failed to list session states: %w", err)
   309→	}
   310→
   311→	for _, state := range states {
   312→		if state.SessionID == excludeSessionID {
   313→			continue
   314→		}
   315→		otherShadow := checkpoint.ShadowBranchNameForCommit(state.BaseCommit, state.WorktreeID)
   316→		if otherShadow == shadowBranch && state.StepCount > 0 {
   317→			return false, nil
   318→		}
   319→	}
   320→
   321→	return true, nil
   322→}
   323→

   110→// TestPostCommit_RebaseDuringActive_SkipsTransition verifies that PostCommit
   111→// is a no-op during rebase operations, leaving the session phase unchanged.
   112→func TestPostCommit_RebaseDuringActive_SkipsTransition(t *testing.T) {
   113→	dir := setupGitRepo(t)
   114→	t.Chdir(dir)
   115→
   116→	repo, err := git.PlainOpen(dir)
   117→	require.NoError(t, err)
   118→
   119→	s := &ManualCommitStrategy{}
   120→	sessionID := "test-postcommit-rebase"
   121→
   122→	// Initialize session and save a checkpoint
   123→	setupSessionWithCheckpoint(t, s, repo, dir, sessionID)
   124→
   125→	// Set phase to ACTIVE
   126→	state, err := s.loadSessionState(sessionID)
   127→	require.NoError(t, err)
   128→	state.Phase = session.PhaseActive
   129→	require.NoError(t, s.saveSessionState(state))
   130→
   131→	// Capture shadow branch name BEFORE any state changes
   132→	shadowBranch := getShadowBranchNameForCommit(state.BaseCommit, state.WorktreeID)
   133→	originalStepCount := state.StepCount
   134→
   135→	// Simulate rebase in progress by creating .git/rebase-merge/ directory
   136→	gitDir := filepath.Join(dir, ".git")
   137→	rebaseMergeDir := filepath.Join(gitDir, "rebase-merge")
   138→	require.NoError(t, os.MkdirAll(rebaseMergeDir, 0o755))
   139→	defer os.RemoveAll(rebaseMergeDir)
   140→
   141→	// Create a commit WITH the checkpoint trailer
   142→	commitWithCheckpointTrailer(t, repo, dir, "c3d4e5f6a1b2")
   143→
   144→	// Run PostCommit
   145→	err = s.PostCommit()
   146→	require.NoError(t, err)
   147→
   148→	// Verify phase stayed ACTIVE (no transition during rebase)
   149→	state, err = s.loadSessionState(sessionID)
   150→	require.NoError(t, err)
   151→	require.NotNil(t, state)
   152→	assert.Equal(t, session.PhaseActive, state.Phase,
   153→		"session should stay ACTIVE during rebase (no transition)")
   154→
   155→	// Verify StepCount was NOT reset (no condensation happened)
   156→	assert.Equal(t, originalStepCount, state.StepCount,
   157→		"StepCount should be unchanged - no condensation during rebase")
   158→
   159→	// Verify NO condensation happened (entire/sessions branch should not exist)
   160→	_, err = repo.Reference(plumbing.NewBranchReferenceName(paths.MetadataBranchName), true)
   161→	require.Error(t, err,
   162→		"entire/sessions branch should NOT exist - no condensation during rebase")
   163→
   164→	// Verify shadow branch still exists (not cleaned up during rebase)
   165→	refName := plumbing.NewBranchReferenceName(shadowBranch)
   166→	_, err = repo.Reference(refName, true)
   167→	assert.NoError(t, err,
   168→		"shadow branch should be preserved during rebase")
   169→}

   171→// TestPostCommit_ShadowBranch_PreservedWhenActiveSessionExists verifies that
   172→// the shadow branch is preserved when ANY session on it is still active,
   173→// even if another session on the same branch is IDLE and gets condensed.
   174→func TestPostCommit_ShadowBranch_PreservedWhenActiveSessionExists(t *testing.T) {
   175→	dir := setupGitRepo(t)
   176→	t.Chdir(dir)
   177→
   178→	repo, err := git.PlainOpen(dir)
   179→	require.NoError(t, err)
   180→
   181→	s := &ManualCommitStrategy{}
   182→	idleSessionID := "test-postcommit-idle-multi"
   183→	activeSessionID := "test-postcommit-active-multi"
   184→
   185→	// Initialize the idle session with a checkpoint
   186→	setupSessionWithCheckpoint(t, s, repo, dir, idleSessionID)
   187→
   188→	// Get worktree path and base commit from the idle session
   189→	idleState, err := s.loadSessionState(idleSessionID)
   190→	require.NoError(t, err)
   191→	worktreePath := idleState.WorktreePath
   192→	baseCommit := idleState.BaseCommit
   193→	worktreeID := idleState.WorktreeID
   194→
   195→	// Set idle session to IDLE phase
   196→	idleState.Phase = session.PhaseIdle
   197→	idleState.LastInteractionTime = nil
   198→	require.NoError(t, s.saveSessionState(idleState))
   199→
   200→	// Create a second session with the SAME base commit and worktree (concurrent session)
   201→	// Save the active session with ACTIVE phase and some checkpoints
   202→	now := time.Now()
   203→	activeState := &SessionState{
   204→		SessionID:           activeSessionID,
   205→		BaseCommit:          baseCommit,
   206→		WorktreePath:        worktreePath,
   207→		WorktreeID:          worktreeID,
   208→		StartedAt:           now,
   209→		Phase:               session.PhaseActive,
   210→		LastInteractionTime: &now,
   211→		StepCount:           1,
   212→	}
   213→	require.NoError(t, s.saveSessionState(activeState))
   214→
   215→	// Create a commit WITH the checkpoint trailer
   216→	commitWithCheckpointTrailer(t, repo, dir, "d4e5f6a1b2c3")
   217→
   218→	// Run PostCommit
   219→	err = s.PostCommit()
   220→	require.NoError(t, err)
   221→
   222→	// Verify the ACTIVE session's phase is now ACTIVE_COMMITTED
   223→	activeState, err = s.loadSessionState(activeSessionID)
   224→	require.NoError(t, err)
   225→	assert.Equal(t, session.PhaseActiveCommitted, activeState.Phase,
   226→		"ACTIVE session should transition to ACTIVE_COMMITTED on GitCommit")
   227→
   228→	// Verify the IDLE session actually condensed (entire/sessions branch should exist)
   229→	idleState, err = s.loadSessionState(idleSessionID)
   230→	require.NoError(t, err)
   231→	sessionsRef, err := repo.Reference(plumbing.NewBranchReferenceName(paths.MetadataBranchName), true)
   232→	require.NoError(t, err, "entire/sessions branch should exist after IDLE session condensation")
   233→	require.NotNil(t, sessionsRef)
   234→
   235→	// Verify IDLE session's StepCount was reset by condensation
   236→	assert.Equal(t, 0, idleState.StepCount,
   237→		"IDLE session StepCount should be reset after condensation")
   238→
   239→	// Verify shadow branch is NOT deleted because the ACTIVE session still needs it.
   240→	// After PostCommit, BaseCommit is updated to new HEAD via migration.
   241→	newShadowBranch := getShadowBranchNameForCommit(activeState.BaseCommit, activeState.WorktreeID)
   242→	refName := plumbing.NewBranchReferenceName(newShadowBranch)
   243→	_, err = repo.Reference(refName, true)
   244→	assert.NoError(t, err,
   245→		"shadow branch should be preserved when an active session still exists on it")
   246→}

   248→// setupSessionWithCheckpoint initializes a session and creates one checkpoint

   250→func setupSessionWithCheckpoint(t *testing.T, s *ManualCommitStrategy, _ *git.Repository, dir, sessionID string) {

   165→// TestPrepareCommitMsg_PendingCheckpointIDReuse verifies that when a session has a
   166→// PendingCheckpointID set (from prior condensation), it is reused regardless of the
   167→// commit source. This is a table-driven test covering two key paths:
   168→//
   169→//   - source="" (editor flow): PendingCheckpointID is reused as an idempotent ID
   170→//   - source="message" (-m flag): PendingCheckpointID triggers isRestoringExisting=true,
   171→//     skipping the interactive TTY prompt. This is critical for non-interactive
   172→//     environments (e.g., Claude doing `git commit --amend -m`) where /dev/tty is
   173→//     unavailable and askConfirmTTY would silently return false, dropping the trailer.
   174→func TestPrepareCommitMsg_PendingCheckpointIDReuse(t *testing.T) {
   175→	tests := []struct {

   183→			name:      "editor flow reuses pending ID",
   184→			source:    "",
   185→			sessionID: "test-session-normal-pending",
   186→			pendingID: "fedcba987654",
   187→			commitMsg: "Feature: add new functionality\n",
   188→		},
   189→		{
   190→			name:      "message source auto-restores without TTY prompt",
   191→			source:    "message",
   192→			sessionID: "test-session-message-restore",
   193→			pendingID: "aabb11223344",
   194→			commitMsg: "Amended message via -m flag\n",
   195→		},
   196→	}
   197→
   198→	for _, tc := range tests {
   199→		t.Run(tc.name, func(t *testing.T) {
   200→			s := setupSessionWithPendingCheckpoint(t, tc.sessionID, tc.pendingID)
   201→
   202→			commitMsgFile := filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "COMMIT_EDITMSG")
   203→			require.NoError(t, os.WriteFile(commitMsgFile, []byte(tc.commitMsg), 0o644))
   204→
   205→			err := s.PrepareCommitMsg(commitMsgFile, tc.source)
   206→			require.NoError(t, err)
   207→
   208→			content, err := os.ReadFile(commitMsgFile)
   209→			require.NoError(t, err)
   210→
   211→			cpID, found := trailers.ParseCheckpoint(string(content))
   212→			assert.True(t, found, "trailer should be added for source=%q with PendingCheckpointID", tc.source)
   213→			assert.Equal(t, tc.pendingID, cpID.String(),
   214→				"trailer should reuse PendingCheckpointID value")

   219→// createShadowBranchWithTranscript creates a shadow branch commit with a minimal
   220→// transcript file so that filterSessionsWithNewContent detects new content.
   221→// This uses low-level go-git plumbing to create the branch directly.
   222→func createShadowBranchWithTranscript(t *testing.T, repoDir string, sessionID string) {
   223→	t.Helper()
   224→
   225→	repo, err := git.PlainOpen(repoDir)
   226→	require.NoError(t, err)
   227→
   228→	head, err := repo.Head()
   229→	require.NoError(t, err)
   230→	baseCommit := head.Hash().String()
   231→
   232→	// Build the tree with a transcript file at the expected path
   233→	metadataDir := paths.EntireMetadataDir + "/" + sessionID
   234→	transcriptPath := metadataDir + "/" + paths.TranscriptFileName
   235→	transcriptContent := `{"type":"message","role":"assistant","content":"hello"}` + "\n"
   236→
   237→	// Create blob for transcript
   238→	blobObj := &plumbing.MemoryObject{}
   239→	blobObj.SetType(plumbing.BlobObject)
   240→	blobObj.SetSize(int64(len(transcriptContent)))
   241→	writer, err := blobObj.Writer()
   242→	require.NoError(t, err)
   243→	_, err = writer.Write([]byte(transcriptContent))
   244→	require.NoError(t, err)
   245→	require.NoError(t, writer.Close())
   246→
   247→	blobHash, err := repo.Storer.SetEncodedObject(blobObj)
   248→	require.NoError(t, err)
   249→
   250→	// Build nested tree structure: .entire/metadata/<sessionID>/full.jsonl
   251→	// We need to build trees bottom-up
   252→	innerTree := object.Tree{
   253→		Entries: []object.TreeEntry{
   254→			{Name: paths.TranscriptFileName, Mode: 0o100644, Hash: blobHash},
   255→		},
   256→	}
   257→	innerTreeObj := repo.Storer.NewEncodedObject()
   258→	innerTreeObj.SetType(plumbing.TreeObject)
   259→	require.NoError(t, innerTree.Encode(innerTreeObj))
   260→	innerTreeHash, err := repo.Storer.SetEncodedObject(innerTreeObj)
   261→	require.NoError(t, err)
   262→
   263→	// Build .entire/metadata/<sessionID> level
   264→	sessionTree := object.Tree{
   265→		Entries: []object.TreeEntry{
   266→			{Name: sessionID, Mode: 0o040000, Hash: innerTreeHash},
   267→		},
   268→	}
   269→	sessionTreeObj := repo.Storer.NewEncodedObject()
   270→	sessionTreeObj.SetType(plumbing.TreeObject)
   271→	require.NoError(t, sessionTree.Encode(sessionTreeObj))
   272→	sessionTreeHash, err := repo.Storer.SetEncodedObject(sessionTreeObj)
   273→	require.NoError(t, err)
   274→
   275→	// Build .entire/metadata level
   276→	metadataTree := object.Tree{
   277→		Entries: []object.TreeEntry{

    11→// Phase represents the lifecycle stage of a session.
    12→type Phase string
    13→
    14→const (
    15→	PhaseActive          Phase = "active"

    24→// PhaseFromString normalizes a phase string, treating empty or unknown values
    25→// as PhaseIdle for backward compatibility with pre-state-machine session files.
    26→func PhaseFromString(s string) Phase {
    27→	switch Phase(s) {
    28→	case PhaseActive:
    29→		return PhaseActive
    30→	case PhaseActiveCommitted:
    31→		return PhaseActiveCommitted
    32→	case PhaseIdle:
    33→		return PhaseIdle
    34→	case PhaseEnded:
    35→		return PhaseEnded
    36→	default:

    38→	}

   114→// TransitionContext provides read-only context for transitions that need
   115→// to inspect session state without mutating it.
   116→type TransitionContext struct {

   118→	IsRebaseInProgress bool // .git/rebase-merge/ or .git/rebase-apply/ exists

   121→// TransitionResult holds the outcome of a state machine transition.
   122→type TransitionResult struct {
   123→	NewPhase Phase
   124→	Actions  []Action
   125→}
   126→
   127→// Transition computes the next phase and required actions given the current
   128→// phase and an event. This is a pure function with no side effects.
   129→//
   130→// Empty or unknown phase values are normalized to PhaseIdle for backward
   131→// compatibility with session state files created before phase tracking.
   132→func Transition(current Phase, event Event, ctx TransitionContext) TransitionResult {
   133→	// Normalize empty/unknown phase to idle for backward compatibility.
   134→	current = PhaseFromString(string(current))
   135→
   136→	switch current {
   137→	case PhaseIdle:
   138→		return transitionFromIdle(event, ctx)
   139→	case PhaseActive:
   140→		return transitionFromActive(event, ctx)
   141→	case PhaseActiveCommitted:
   142→		return transitionFromActiveCommitted(event, ctx)
   143→	case PhaseEnded:
   144→		return transitionFromEnded(event, ctx)
   145→	default:
   146→		// PhaseFromString guarantees we only get known phases, but the
   147→		// exhaustive linter requires handling the default case.
   148→		return TransitionResult{NewPhase: PhaseIdle}
   149→	}
   150→}
   151→
   152→func transitionFromIdle(event Event, ctx TransitionContext) TransitionResult {
   153→	switch event {
   154→	case EventTurnStart:
   155→		return TransitionResult{
   156→			NewPhase: PhaseActive,
   157→			Actions:  []Action{ActionUpdateLastInteraction},
   158→		}
   159→	case EventTurnEnd:
   160→		// Turn end while idle is a no-op (no active turn to end).
   161→		return TransitionResult{NewPhase: PhaseIdle}
   162→	case EventGitCommit:
   163→		if ctx.IsRebaseInProgress {
   164→			return TransitionResult{NewPhase: PhaseIdle}
   165→		}
   166→		return TransitionResult{
   167→			NewPhase: PhaseIdle,
   168→			Actions:  []Action{ActionCondense, ActionUpdateLastInteraction},
   169→		}
   170→	case EventSessionStart:
   171→		// Already condensable, no-op.
   172→		return TransitionResult{NewPhase: PhaseIdle}
   173→	case EventSessionStop:
   174→		return TransitionResult{
   175→			NewPhase: PhaseEnded,
   176→			Actions:  []Action{ActionUpdateLastInteraction},
   177→		}
   178→	default:
   179→		return TransitionResult{NewPhase: PhaseIdle}
   180→	}
   181→}
   182→
   183→func transitionFromActive(event Event, ctx TransitionContext) TransitionResult {
   184→	switch event {
   185→	case EventTurnStart:
   186→		// Ctrl-C recovery: just continue.
   187→		return TransitionResult{
   188→			NewPhase: PhaseActive,
   189→			Actions:  []Action{ActionUpdateLastInteraction},
   190→		}
   191→	case EventTurnEnd:
   192→		return TransitionResult{
   193→			NewPhase: PhaseIdle,
   194→			Actions:  []Action{ActionUpdateLastInteraction},
   195→		}
   196→	case EventGitCommit:
   197→		if ctx.IsRebaseInProgress {
   198→			return TransitionResult{NewPhase: PhaseActive}
   199→		}
   200→		return TransitionResult{
   201→			NewPhase: PhaseActiveCommitted,
   202→			Actions:  []Action{ActionMigrateShadowBranch, ActionUpdateLastInteraction},
   203→		}
   204→	case EventSessionStart:
   205→		return TransitionResult{
   206→			NewPhase: PhaseActive,
   207→			Actions:  []Action{ActionWarnStaleSession},
   208→		}
   209→	case EventSessionStop:
   210→		return TransitionResult{
   211→			NewPhase: PhaseEnded,
   212→			Actions:  []Action{ActionUpdateLastInteraction},
   213→		}
   214→	default:
   215→		return TransitionResult{NewPhase: PhaseActive}
   216→	}
   217→}
   218→
   219→func transitionFromActiveCommitted(event Event, ctx TransitionContext) TransitionResult {
   220→	switch event {
   221→	case EventTurnStart:
   222→		// Ctrl-C recovery after commit.
   223→		return TransitionResult{
   224→			NewPhase: PhaseActive,
   225→			Actions:  []Action{ActionUpdateLastInteraction},
   226→		}
   227→	case EventTurnEnd:
   228→		return TransitionResult{
   229→			NewPhase: PhaseIdle,
   230→			Actions:  []Action{ActionCondense, ActionUpdateLastInteraction},
   231→		}
   232→	case EventGitCommit:
   233→		if ctx.IsRebaseInProgress {
   234→			return TransitionResult{NewPhase: PhaseActiveCommitted}
   235→		}
   236→		return TransitionResult{
   237→			NewPhase: PhaseActiveCommitted,
   238→			Actions:  []Action{ActionMigrateShadowBranch, ActionUpdateLastInteraction},
   239→		}
   240→	case EventSessionStart:
   241→		return TransitionResult{
   242→			NewPhase: PhaseActiveCommitted,
   243→			Actions:  []Action{ActionWarnStaleSession},
   244→		}
   245→	case EventSessionStop:
   246→		return TransitionResult{
   247→			NewPhase: PhaseEnded,
   248→			Actions:  []Action{ActionUpdateLastInteraction},
   249→		}
   250→	default:
   251→		return TransitionResult{NewPhase: PhaseActiveCommitted}
   252→	}
   253→}
   254→
   255→func transitionFromEnded(event Event, ctx TransitionContext) TransitionResult {
   256→	switch event {
   257→	case EventTurnStart:
   258→		return TransitionResult{
   259→			NewPhase: PhaseActive,
   260→			Actions:  []Action{ActionClearEndedAt, ActionUpdateLastInteraction},
   261→		}
   262→	case EventTurnEnd:
   263→		// Turn end while ended is a no-op.
   264→		return TransitionResult{NewPhase: PhaseEnded}
   265→	case EventGitCommit:
   266→		if ctx.IsRebaseInProgress {
   267→			return TransitionResult{NewPhase: PhaseEnded}
   268→		}
   269→		if ctx.HasFilesTouched {
   270→			return TransitionResult{
   271→				NewPhase: PhaseEnded,
   272→				Actions:  []Action{ActionCondenseIfFilesTouched, ActionUpdateLastInteraction},
   273→			}
   274→		}
   275→		return TransitionResult{
   276→			NewPhase: PhaseEnded,
   277→			Actions:  []Action{ActionDiscardIfNoFiles, ActionUpdateLastInteraction},
   278→		}
   279→	case EventSessionStart:
   280→		return TransitionResult{
   281→			NewPhase: PhaseIdle,
   282→			Actions:  []Action{ActionClearEndedAt},
   283→		}
   284→	case EventSessionStop:
   285→		// Already ended, no-op.
   286→		return TransitionResult{NewPhase: PhaseEnded}
   287→	default:
   288→		return TransitionResult{NewPhase: PhaseEnded}
   289→	}
   290→}
   291→
   292→// ApplyCommonActions applies the common (non-strategy-specific) actions from a
   293→// TransitionResult to the given State. It updates Phase, LastInteractionTime,
   294→// and EndedAt as indicated by the transition.
   295→//
   296→// Returns the subset of actions that require strategy-specific handling
   297→// (e.g., ActionCondense, ActionMigrateShadowBranch, ActionWarnStaleSession).
   298→// The caller is responsible for dispatching those.
   299→func ApplyCommonActions(state *State, result TransitionResult) []Action {
   300→	state.Phase = result.NewPhase
   301→
   302→	var remaining []Action
   303→	for _, action := range result.Actions {
   304→		switch action {
   305→		case ActionUpdateLastInteraction:
   306→			now := time.Now()
   307→			state.LastInteractionTime = &now
   308→		case ActionClearEndedAt:
   309→			state.EndedAt = nil
   310→		case ActionCondense, ActionCondenseIfFilesTouched, ActionDiscardIfNoFiles,
   311→			ActionMigrateShadowBranch, ActionWarnStaleSession:
   312→			// Strategy-specific actions — pass through to caller.
   313→			remaining = append(remaining, action)
   314→		}
   315→	}
   316→	return remaining
   317→}
   318→
   319→// MermaidDiagram generates a Mermaid state diagram from the transition table.
   320→// The diagram is derived by calling Transition() for representative context
   321→// variants per phase/event, so it stays in sync with the implementation.
   322→func MermaidDiagram() string {
   323→	var b strings.Builder
   324→	b.WriteString("stateDiagram-v2\n")
   325→
   326→	// State declarations with descriptions.
   327→	b.WriteString("    state \"IDLE\" as idle\n")
   328→	b.WriteString("    state \"ACTIVE\" as active\n")
   329→	b.WriteString("    state \"ACTIVE_COMMITTED\" as active_committed\n")
   330→	b.WriteString("    state \"ENDED\" as ended\n")
   331→	b.WriteString("\n")
   332→
   333→	// Context variants for GitCommit: rebase, files/no-files.
   334→	type contextVariant struct {
   335→		label string
   336→		ctx   TransitionContext
   337→	}
   338→
   339→	// For each phase/event, generate edges.
   340→	for _, phase := range allPhases {
   341→		for _, event := range allEvents {
   342→			var variants []contextVariant
   343→			switch {
   344→			case event == EventGitCommit && phase == PhaseEnded:
   345→				// HasFilesTouched only affects PhaseEnded transitions;
   346→				// other phases produce identical edges for both values.
   347→				variants = []contextVariant{
   348→					{"[files]", TransitionContext{HasFilesTouched: true}},
   349→					{"[no files]", TransitionContext{HasFilesTouched: false}},
   350→					{"[rebase]", TransitionContext{IsRebaseInProgress: true}},
   351→				}
   352→			case event == EventGitCommit:
   353→				variants = []contextVariant{
   354→					{"", TransitionContext{}},
   355→					{"[rebase]", TransitionContext{IsRebaseInProgress: true}},
   356→				}
   357→			default:
   358→				variants = []contextVariant{
   359→					{"", TransitionContext{}},
   360→				}
   361→			}
   362→
   363→			for _, v := range variants {
   364→				result := Transition(phase, event, v.ctx)
   365→
   366→				// Build edge label.
   367→				label := event.String()
   368→				if v.label != "" {
   369→					label += " " + v.label
   370→				}
   371→				if len(result.Actions) > 0 {
   372→					actionNames := make([]string, 0, len(result.Actions))
   373→					for _, a := range result.Actions {
   374→						actionNames = append(actionNames, a.String())
   375→					}
   376→					label += " / " + strings.Join(actionNames, ", ")
   377→				}
   378→
   379→				from := string(phase)
   380→				to := string(result.NewPhase)
   381→
   382→				fmt.Fprintf(&b, "    %s --> %s : %s\n", from, to, label)
   383→			}
   384→		}
   385→	}
   386→
   387→	return b.String()
   388→}

     1→// Package trailers provides parsing and formatting for Entire commit message trailers.
     2→// Trailers are key-value metadata appended to git commit messages following the
     3→// git trailer convention (key: value format after a blank line).
     4→package trailers
     5→
     6→import (
     7→	"fmt"
     8→	"regexp"
     9→	"strings"
    10→
    11→	checkpointID "github.com/entireio/cli/cmd/entire/cli/checkpoint/id"
    12→)
    13→
    14→// Trailer key constants used in commit messages.
    15→const (
    16→	// MetadataTrailerKey points to the metadata directory within a commit tree.
    17→	MetadataTrailerKey = "Entire-Metadata"
    18→
    19→	// MetadataTaskTrailerKey points to the task metadata directory for subagent checkpoints.
    20→	MetadataTaskTrailerKey = "Entire-Metadata-Task"
    21→
    22→	// StrategyTrailerKey indicates which strategy created the commit.
    23→	StrategyTrailerKey = "Entire-Strategy"
    24→
    25→	// BaseCommitTrailerKey links shadow commits to their base code commit.
    26→	BaseCommitTrailerKey = "Base-Commit"
    27→
    28→	// SessionTrailerKey identifies which session created a commit.
    29→	SessionTrailerKey = "Entire-Session"
    30→
    31→	// CondensationTrailerKey identifies the condensation ID for a commit (legacy).
    32→	CondensationTrailerKey = "Entire-Condensation"
    33→
    34→	// SourceRefTrailerKey links code commits to their metadata on a shadow/metadata branch.
    35→	// Format: "<branch>@<commit-hash>" e.g. "entire/metadata@abc123def456"
    36→	SourceRefTrailerKey = "Entire-Source-Ref"
    37→
    38→	// CheckpointTrailerKey links commits to their checkpoint metadata on entire/sessions.
    39→	// Format: 12 hex characters e.g. "a3b2c4d5e6f7"
    40→	// This trailer survives git amend and rebase operations.
    41→	CheckpointTrailerKey = "Entire-Checkpoint"
    42→
    43→	// EphemeralBranchTrailerKey identifies the shadow branch that a checkpoint originated from.
    44→	// Used in manual-commit strategy checkpoint commits on entire/sessions branch.
    45→	// Format: full branch name e.g. "entire/2b4c177"
    46→	EphemeralBranchTrailerKey = "Ephemeral-branch"
    47→
    48→	// AgentTrailerKey identifies the agent that created a checkpoint.
    49→	// Format: human-readable agent name e.g. "Claude Code", "Cursor"
    50→	AgentTrailerKey = "Entire-Agent"
    51→)
    52→
    53→// Pre-compiled regexes for trailer parsing.
    54→var (
    55→	// Trailer parsing regexes.
    56→	strategyTrailerRegex     = regexp.MustCompile(StrategyTrailerKey + `:\s*(.+)`)
    57→	metadataTrailerRegex     = regexp.MustCompile(MetadataTrailerKey + `:\s*(.+)`)
    58→	taskMetadataTrailerRegex = regexp.MustCompile(MetadataTaskTrailerKey + `:\s*(.+)`)
    59→	baseCommitTrailerRegex   = regexp.MustCompile(BaseCommitTrailerKey + `:\s*([a-f0-9]{40})`)
    60→	condensationTrailerRegex = regexp.MustCompile(CondensationTrailerKey + `:\s*(.+)`)
    61→	sessionTrailerRegex      = regexp.MustCompile(SessionTrailerKey + `:\s*(.+)`)
    62→	checkpointTrailerRegex   = regexp.MustCompile(CheckpointTrailerKey + `:\s*(` + checkpointID.Pattern + `)(?:\s|$)`)
    63→)
    64→
    65→// ParseStrategy extracts strategy from commit message.
    66→// Returns the strategy name and true if found, empty string and false otherwise.
    67→func ParseStrategy(commitMessage string) (string, bool) {
    68→	matches := strategyTrailerRegex.FindStringSubmatch(commitMessage)
    69→	if len(matches) > 1 {
    70→		return strings.TrimSpace(matches[1]), true
    71→	}
    72→	return "", false
    73→}
    74→

    76→// Returns the metadata directory and true if found, empty string and false otherwise.
    77→func ParseMetadata(commitMessage string) (string, bool) {

    81→	}

   115→// ParseSession extracts the session ID from a commit message.

   119→func ParseSession(commitMessage string) (string, bool) {
   120→	matches := sessionTrailerRegex.FindStringSubmatch(commitMessage)
   121→	if len(matches) > 1 {
   122→		return strings.TrimSpace(matches[1]), true
   123→	}
   124→	return "", false
   125→}
   126→
   127→// ParseCheckpoint extracts the checkpoint ID from a commit message.
   128→// Returns the CheckpointID and true if found, empty ID and false otherwise.
   129→func ParseCheckpoint(commitMessage string) (checkpointID.CheckpointID, bool) {
   130→	matches := checkpointTrailerRegex.FindStringSubmatch(commitMessage)
   131→	if len(matches) > 1 {
   132→		idStr := strings.TrimSpace(matches[1])
   133→		// Validate it's a proper checkpoint ID
   134→		if cpID, err := checkpointID.NewCheckpointID(idStr); err == nil {
   135→			return cpID, true
   136→		}
   137→	}
   138→	return checkpointID.EmptyCheckpointID, false
   139→}
   140→
   141→// ParseAllSessions extracts all session IDs from a commit message.
   142→// Returns a slice of session IDs (may be empty if none found).
   143→// Duplicate session IDs are deduplicated while preserving order.
   144→// This is useful for commits that may have multiple Entire-Session trailers.
   145→func ParseAllSessions(commitMessage string) []string {
   146→	matches := sessionTrailerRegex.FindAllStringSubmatch(commitMessage, -1)
   147→	if len(matches) == 0 {
   148→		return nil
   149→	}
   150→
   151→	seen := make(map[string]bool)
   152→	sessionIDs := make([]string, 0, len(matches))
   153→	for _, match := range matches {
   154→		if len(match) > 1 {
   155→			sessionID := strings.TrimSpace(match[1])
   156→			if !seen[sessionID] {
   157→				seen[sessionID] = true
   158→				sessionIDs = append(sessionIDs, sessionID)
   159→			}
   160→		}
   161→	}
   162→	return sessionIDs
   163→}
   164→
   165→// FormatStrategy creates a commit message with just the strategy trailer.
   166→func FormatStrategy(message, strategy string) string {
   167→	return fmt.Sprintf("%s\n\n%s: %s\n", message, StrategyTrailerKey, strategy)
   168→}
   169→
   170→// FormatTaskMetadata creates a commit message with task metadata trailer.
   171→func FormatTaskMetadata(message, taskMetadataDir string) string {
   172→	return fmt.Sprintf("%s\n\n%s: %s\n", message, MetadataTaskTrailerKey, taskMetadataDir)
   173→}
   174→
   175→// FormatTaskMetadataWithStrategy creates a commit message with task metadata and strategy trailers.
   176→func FormatTaskMetadataWithStrategy(message, taskMetadataDir, strategy string) string {
   177→	return fmt.Sprintf("%s\n\n%s: %s\n%s: %s\n", message, MetadataTaskTrailerKey, taskMetadataDir, StrategyTrailerKey, strategy)
   178→}
   179→
   180→// FormatSourceRef creates a formatted source ref string for the trailer.
   181→// Format: "<branch>@<commit-hash-prefix>" (hash truncated to 12 chars)
   182→func FormatSourceRef(branch, commitHash string) string {
   183→	shortHash := commitHash
   184→	if len(shortHash) > 12 {
   185→		shortHash = shortHash[:12]
   186→	}
   187→	return fmt.Sprintf("%s@%s", branch, shortHash)
   188→}
   189→
   190→// FormatMetadata creates a commit message with metadata trailer.
   191→func FormatMetadata(message, metadataDir string) string {
   192→	return fmt.Sprintf("%s\n\n%s: %s\n", message, MetadataTrailerKey, metadataDir)
   193→}
   194→
   195→// FormatMetadataWithStrategy creates a commit message with metadata and strategy trailers.
   196→func FormatMetadataWithStrategy(message, metadataDir, strategy string) string {
   197→	return fmt.Sprintf("%s\n\n%s: %s\n%s: %s\n", message, MetadataTrailerKey, metadataDir, StrategyTrailerKey, strategy)
   198→}
   199→
   200→// FormatShadowCommit creates a commit message for manual-commit strategy checkpoints.
   201→// Includes Entire-Metadata, Entire-Session, and Entire-Strategy trailers.
   202→func FormatShadowCommit(message, metadataDir, sessionID string) string {
   203→	var sb strings.Builder
   204→	sb.WriteString(message)
   205→	sb.WriteString("\n\n")
   206→	sb.WriteString(fmt.Sprintf("%s: %s\n", MetadataTrailerKey, metadataDir))
   207→	sb.WriteString(fmt.Sprintf("%s: %s\n", SessionTrailerKey, sessionID))
   208→	sb.WriteString(fmt.Sprintf("%s: %s\n", StrategyTrailerKey, "manual-commit"))
   209→	return sb.String()
   210→}
   211→
   212→// FormatShadowTaskCommit creates a commit message for manual-commit task checkpoints.
   213→// Includes Entire-Metadata-Task, Entire-Session, and Entire-Strategy trailers.
   214→func FormatShadowTaskCommit(message, taskMetadataDir, sessionID string) string {
   215→	var sb strings.Builder
   216→	sb.WriteString(message)
   217→	sb.WriteString("\n\n")
   218→	sb.WriteString(fmt.Sprintf("%s: %s\n", MetadataTaskTrailerKey, taskMetadataDir))
   219→	sb.WriteString(fmt.Sprintf("%s: %s\n", SessionTrailerKey, sessionID))
   220→	sb.WriteString(fmt.Sprintf("%s: %s\n", StrategyTrailerKey, "manual-commit"))
   221→	return sb.String()
   222→}
   223→
   224→// FormatCheckpoint creates a commit message with a checkpoint trailer.
   225→// This links user commits to their checkpoint metadata on entire/sessions branch.
   226→func FormatCheckpoint(message string, cpID checkpointID.CheckpointID) string {
   227→	return fmt.Sprintf("%s\n\n%s: %s\n", message, CheckpointTrailerKey, cpID.String())
   228→}

## 1. `/Users/alex/workspace/cli/.worktrees/3/cmd/entire/cli/hooks_geminicli_handlers.go` (lines 34-62)

```go
// handleGeminiSessionEnd handles the SessionEnd hook for Gemini CLI.
// This fires when the user explicitly exits the session (via "exit" or "logout" commands).
// Note: The primary checkpoint creation happens in AfterAgent (equivalent to Claude's Stop).
// SessionEnd serves as a cleanup/fallback - it will commit any uncommitted changes that
// weren't captured by AfterAgent (e.g., if the user exits mid-response).
func handleGeminiSessionEnd() error {
	// Set up logging context
	ag, err := GetCurrentHookAgent()
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("failed to get agent: %w", err)
	}
	logCtx := logging.WithAgent(logging.WithComponent(context.Background(), "hooks"), ag.Name())

	// Commit any uncommitted changes (consumes stdin)
	if err := commitWithMetadataGemini(); err != nil {
		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Warning: failed to commit metadata: %v\n", err)
	}

	// Mark session as ended (find most recent active session since stdin consumed)
	entireSessionID := strategy.FindMostRecentSession()
	if entireSessionID != "" {
		logging.Info(logCtx, "session-end-mark",
			slog.String("hook", "session-end"),
			slog.String("hook_type", "agent"),
			slog.String("entire_session_id", entireSessionID),
		)

		if err := markSessionEnded(entireSessionID); err != nil {
			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Warning: failed to mark session ended: %v\n", err)
		}
	}

	return nil
}
```

The Copilot comment on line 47 is: **"find most recent active session since stdin consumed"** — this explains why `strategy.FindMostRecentSession()` is called after `commitWithMetadataGemini()` (which consumes stdin), rather than retrieving the session ID from the hook input earlier.

## 2. `/Users/alex/workspace/cli/.worktrees/3/cmd/entire/cli/strategy/manual_commit_reset.go` (lines 90-129)

```go
// ResetSession clears a single session's state and removes the shadow branch
// if no other sessions reference it. File changes remain in the working directory.
func (s *ManualCommitStrategy) ResetSession(sessionID string) error {
	// Load the session state
	state, err := s.loadSessionState(sessionID)
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("failed to load session state: %w", err)
	}
	if state == nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("session not found: %s", sessionID)
	}

	// Clear the session state file
	if err := s.clearSessionState(sessionID); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("failed to clear session state: %w", err)
	}
	fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Cleared session state for %s\n", sessionID)

	// Determine the shadow branch for this session
	shadowBranchName := getShadowBranchNameForCommit(state.BaseCommit, state.WorktreeID)

	// Open repository
	repo, err := OpenRepository()
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("failed to open repository: %w", err)
	}

	// Clean up shadow branch if no other sessions need it
	if err := s.cleanupShadowBranchIfUnused(repo, shadowBranchName, sessionID); err != nil {
		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Warning: failed to clean up shadow branch %s: %v\n", shadowBranchName, err)
	} else {
		// Check if it was actually deleted (branch no longer exists)
		refName := plumbing.NewBranchReferenceName(shadowBranchName)
		if _, refErr := repo.Reference(refName, true); refErr != nil {
			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Deleted shadow branch %s\n", shadowBranchName)
		}
	}

	return nil
}
```

The Copilot review comments on lines 106, 119, and 124 all relate to **`os.Stderr` usage**. These are user-facing messages output directly to stderr (using `fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, ...)`). The review likely flagged these as side effects that should potentially be removed or wrapped in a logging abstraction instead.

{
  "title": "Remove os.Stderr side effects from Strategy interface methods",
  "team": "Entire",
  "project": "Troy",
  "priority": 4,
  "description": "## Context\n\n`ResetSession()` (and potentially other Strategy interface methods) write user-facing output directly to `os.Stderr` via `fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, ...)`. This bypasses Cobra's `cmd.ErrOrStderr()`/`cmd.OutOrStdout()` streams and makes the methods harder to test.\n\nFlagged by Copilot review on PR #174 ([thread 1](https://github.com/entireio/cli/pull/174#discussion_r2778195671), [thread 2](https://github.com/entireio/cli/pull/174#discussion_r2778195680)).\n\n## Problem\n\n- `ResetSession` is part of the `Strategy` interface (`strategy.go:486`), so threading `io.Writer` changes the interface signature across all implementations\n- The strategy package doesn't have access to `*cobra.Command`, so it can't use `cmd.ErrOrStderr()`\n- Direct `os.Stderr` writes can't be captured in tests\n\n## Affected files\n\n- `cmd/entire/cli/strategy/manual_commit_reset.go` — `ResetSession()` lines 107, 121, 125\n\n## Options\n\n1. **Add `io.Writer` parameter to `ResetSession`** — cleanest but changes the interface\n2. **Return a result struct** with status messages, let the CLI layer print — more invasive but fully decoupled\n3. **Use `logging` package** for operational messages — aligns with CLAUDE.md guidelines, but these are user-facing messages not internal diagnostics\n\n## Related\n\n- ENT-245: Deduplicate `canDeleteShadowBranch` and `cleanupShadowBranchIfUnused`\n- PR #174 also fixed the same `os.Stderr` pattern in `discardSession()` (cli package, not interface method)",
  "labels": [
    "Tech Debt"
  ]
}
```
